decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation for heat exchangers builds directly on the firm's automation and energy-recovery know-how, and its own R&D and university cooperation give it the absorptive capacity to read early results and refine the product rather than abandon it.

A web tool for weir dimensioning draws on the firm's documented hydraulic engineering experience from thousands of flood-control projects and runs on its existing IT modules, so it is cheap to maintain and easy for the firm to improve.
The fouling detection system complements Product A and fits the strategic push toward energy recovery from wastewater, which the firm's R&D and EU research projects position it to develop further.
